## Problem and scope

Describe the problem, the change, and explicit non-goals.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm verify`
- [ ] Relevant bad cases added or updated
- [ ] Desktop/mobile and accessibility impact checked where applicable

## Governance and documentation

- [ ] STATUS/DECISIONS/RISKS/ASSUMPTIONS updated if their state changed
- [ ] Privacy, expiry, correction, export/delete, and cannot-claim boundaries preserved
- [ ] No deployment, field-use, production, or product-evidence claim is introduced

## Rights and repository hygiene

- [ ] No secret, private data, real location, NUS-owned material, or unauthorised asset is included
- [ ] Generated builds, reports, traces, caches, and unrelated screenshots are not included
- [ ] Dependency/provenance/notices were refreshed if dependencies changed
- [ ] Fixture contributions are original/controlled by the contributor and intentionally dedicated under CC0-1.0
- [ ] Other contributions are submitted under MIT
